summary.text: Tonya Hudson is the Libertarian nominee for Indiana's 9th Congressional District, a real estate broker born in Indianapolis who has run in prior elections on reducing taxes and government regulation.

paragraphs.text: Born in Indianapolis, Indiana, and graduated from John Marshall High School.

Works as a real estate broker in southern Indiana; her Ballotpedia profile lists affiliations with the Lions Club and the Indiana Association of Realtors. Earlier, she recalls working as a health aide in the Brown County High School nurse's office around 2001.
Ran as the Libertarian candidate for Indiana's 9th Congressional District in 2022, finishing third with 2.8% of the vote (6,374 votes) in the race won by Erin Houchin.

Ran as the Libertarian candidate for Lieutenant Governor of Indiana in 2024, winning 4.5% (129,781 votes); Micah Beckwith (R) won the office. She was selected at the Libertarian state convention over Tommy Brown III.
Advanced from the Libertarian convention for the 9th District on March 22, 2026.
